description: Eval coverage for /agada-bench. Two mode families: BENCH-MODE (default, score live BL recall vs standing gold) and BUILD-MODE (subcommand, extend standing corpus with new domain). Static smoke runs all of them; full live BL smoke requires MCP access (operator-driven, see workflows/run-bench.md).

cases.name: BENCH-MODE: run-bench.py prepare loads 4 historical golds + reconstructs 67 queries
assertions: Every non-_meta row has query_text and query_filters fields (W0 #2: QUERY RECONSTRUCTION from phase-0b-corpus)
Every non-_meta row has expected_gold list populated from gold.jsonl

cases.name: BENCH-MODE: run-bench.py score computes correct recall@K on synthetic perfect results
cases.description: Feed synthetic bench-results.jsonl where every gold-L3 query returns expected chunks at positions 1..N. Verify the math.
setup: Generate synthetic bench-results.jsonl with every expected_gold chunk at position i+1, provenance=true_hit, source_session_id=sim-prior, chunk_created_iso=2026-04-01T00:00:00Z
assertions: Per-domain breakdown present for techgym, freelance, recruiting, architecture
Architecture flagged as LOW-POWER in report markdown

cases.name: BENCH-MODE: run-bench.py score uses append-mode chunked writes (W0 #1)
cases.description: Verify that long report writes don't fail on large payloads.
assertions: scripts/run-bench.py contains append_chunked helper that writes ≤2048 byte segments via 'ab' mode
scripts/run-bench.py score truncates output before append (write_text('')) then chunked-appends sections
Synthetic test with 67-query report produces complete output (no truncation)

cases.name: TOP-LEVEL: run-agada.sh (no args) routes to bench mode
assertions: Output dir queries path uses YYYY-MM-DD prefix

cases.name: TOP-LEVEL: run-agada.sh build routes to build mode
extract-corpus.py parses tiny-session.jsonl into an 8-row corpus
assertions: corpus.jsonl row count is between 8 and 9 (5 brain_search calls returned: 3+2+0+2+1 = 8 chunks; zero-result query 3 goes to zero-result-queries.jsonl)
Every row has required fields: query_id, query_text, chunk_id, chunk_full_content, audit_returned_position, audit_score
/tmp/agada-eval-extract-minimal/zero-result-queries.jsonl exists with 1 row (the synthetic 'laptop liquid spill' query)
Hebrew content in rt-fix-cccc-1 is preserved verbatim (דוגמה לחשבונית present in chunk_full_content)

cases.name: liveness-check.py reports ALIVE for a complete claude-only fixture run
setup: Generate claude.jsonl with the same 3 (qid, chunk_id) rows graded.

cases.name: liveness-check.py FAILS LOUD when a judge is under-quota (FM13)
setup: Generate gemini.jsonl with only 6 rows (60% = below 95% threshold).
assertions: liveness-report.md contains 'geminiJudge' AND ('DEAD' OR 'under quota' OR 'FAIL')

cases.name: kappa-matrix.py reproduces W3.2's empirical baseline on Runs 2/3/4 phase-1-judgments
assertions: kappa.md contains 'claude × cursor' pair with κ between 0.70 and 0.90 (W3.2 reported 0.811)
kappa.md contains 'codex × gemini' pair with κ between 0.30 and 0.50 (W3.2 reported 0.38)
kappa.md drop-judge recommendation contains 'cursorJudge' (highest-κ pair member)

cases.name: Refactored build-crossref.py produces output ≥95% identical to the original on Run 1's data
assertions: consensus-draft.jsonl row count matches original within ±2 rows
consensus-draft.jsonl 'unanimous' bucket count matches original within ±2

cases.name: Refactored build-gold.py produces ≥95% identical gold.jsonl to the original on Run 1's data
assertions: Exit code == 0 OR (exit 2 AND notes mention unresolved rows expected for route-pending-rt.py)
Diff of gold.jsonl vs gold.jsonl.original: ≥ 95% of rows have identical gold_label

cases.name: route-pending-rt.py identifies Run 1's hard pair and routes correctly under each cascade mode
assertions: Output identifies the Run 1 hard pair (qid=1, chunk_id=rt-3f77d29a-ad11c3648797a588) — historically the spread-2 case requiring red-team
pending-rt-routing.md contains route classification ('cascade-opus' OR 'discard-fm14' OR 'etan-adjudicate')
When --cascade is 'opus-4-7' (v1 stub), cascade-queue.md is emitted with pending-cascade rows

cases.name: run-agada.sh --dry-run on tiny-session.jsonl prints the dispatch plan without spawning judges
assertions: stdout does NOT contain 'cmux MCP error' (dry-run skips actual spawn)
Output dir /tmp/agada-eval-driver-dryrun/phase-0b-corpus/corpus.jsonl exists after extract phase ran
No phase-2-crossref/ output (dry-run halts before crossref since judges didn't run)

cases.name: Re-running /agada-bench on Run 1's coach session reproduces ≥95% of the original gold
cases.description: Full pipeline run on a private reference session. Requires actual 3-judge dispatch via cmux MCP — this case is run manually by the operator, not by automated eval harness. Listed here for completeness.

operator_steps: Spawn the 4 judges via cmux MCP per the printed dispatch plan.
Wait for all 4 <judge>.jsonl files to fill.
Press Enter in the run-agada.sh prompt to continue with liveness + crossref + gold-lock.

assertions: Diff vs /opt/private/coordination/docs.local/plans/2026-05-15-agada-bench-4way-judge/phase-3-gold/gold.jsonl: ≥ 95% of rows have identical gold_label (allow 5% slack for judge stochasticity)
FM12 incident reproducible: liveness-check flags geminiJudge integrity failure (~18 off-corpus rows)
